verdict.rationale: Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU without an integrated GPU, and the evidence pack contains no mention of hardware video encode/decode engines (AV1, HEVC, ProRes) on the chip; creative acceleration claims refer only to general CPU compute power for rendering/color-grading, not dedicated media engines. missing for 10: any documentation of on-die hardware video encoder/decoder, codec support list, or streaming/encoding acceleration hardware.
